files.title_zh: 提案封面：京张令牌识别装置
files.title_en: Proposal cover: the Token Block identity device
files.description_zh: 一条实线在三处按真实里程断开为虚线（三站），线上方两枚菱形为两处道岔；断点位置由三处重点片区形心在主脊 ROAD-001 上的里程投影计算，非手工摆放。概念方案，非官方渲染。
files.description_en: One solid rule broken into dashed segments at the three stations, with two diamonds for the two switches. Break positions are computed from the projected chainage of the three key-area centroids on the ROAD-001 main-line alignment. Conceptual, not an official rendering.

files.title_zh: 跑一枚令牌：离线三维走廊交互
files.title_en: Run a Token: offline 3D corridor interactive
files.description_zh: 内嵌于 visual/index.html「跑一枚令牌」章节的离线交互逻辑与数据（本地打包 three.js）：一枚令牌沿主脊从 S1 跑到 S6，进入某段即高亮该段并显示区间名称与场景卡数量；同一时刻线上只允许一枚令牌。支持键盘操作、prefers-reduced-motion 逐段跳转、WebGL 失败与无脚本时的内联静态俯视图回退。挤出高度为示意符号，非建筑体量提案。
files.description_en: Logic and embedded data for the “Run a token” section of visual/index.html (three.js bundled locally): one token runs the main line S1→S6, highlighting the occupied section with its name and scenario-card count; only one token may be on the line at a time. Keyboard operable, reduced-motion stepping, and an inline static top-view fallback for no-WebGL and no-JavaScript. Extruded heights are symbolic markers, not a building-volume proposal.

files.description_zh: visual/token-run.html 使用的第三方渲染库，版本固定为 r160，随包本地打包，保留原始 MIT 许可头；运行期不发起任何网络请求。
files.description_en: Third-party rendering library used by visual/token-run.html, pinned to r160 and bundled locally with its original MIT licence header; it makes no network request at runtime.

files.description_zh: 确定性脚本对本包自身数据实际执行的 80 项合成复演（55 项负分支）：场景准入、令牌周期、协议状态机与几何拓扑校验；负分支成功 = 规则正确拒绝。不构成现场证据或运营批准。
files.description_en: 80 synthetic replay tasks (55 negative branches) executed by a deterministic script against this package's own data: scenario admission, token cycles, protocol state-machine branches and geometry-topology checks. A negative branch succeeds when the rule correctly refuses. Not field evidence and not an approval.

files.title_zh: 首期一百天交付框架（工作包/退出门/采购主题/监测窗）
files.title_en: First-100-days delivery frame (work packages / exit gates / procurement themes / monitoring windows)
files.description_zh: 机读实施层：10 个工作包（前置条件/依赖/证据产出/相对投入量级）、G0–G4 五道退出门、8 类采购主题（不含金额）、3/12/36 月监测窗（写明六项绩效指标何时开始积累真实数据）。不构成实施、采购或投资承诺。
files.description_en: Machine-readable delivery layer: 10 work packages (precondition/dependency/evidence output/relative effort class), exit gates G0-G4, 8 procurement themes (no amounts), and 3/12/36-month monitoring windows stating when each of the six performance metrics starts accruing real data. Not a delivery, procurement or investment commitment.

validation_claim.data_confidence_note: Design layers and metrics are fully recomputable, but the submitted boundary and the three key-area polygons are the repository's provisional rough boundaries, not an official redline.
